title: Midnight Train Blues — Call and Response
tuning: E A D G B E
learningGoal: Melodic call-and-response, expressive pauses, chromatic blue notes and an independent alternating thumb
practiceInstructions: Tune EADGBE; play thumb p on bass and i/m/a on treble strings; no pick or percussion. Start at 60 BPM, feel the eighth notes long-short, keep the bass steady and hold the last melody note four beats.
successCriteria: Even alternating bass at quarter-note pulse
Deliberate upper voice rests and contrasting phrases
E7/A7/C#7/F#m7/B7 chord movement and closing E tonic
Musical articulation: question/answer and final sustained E
